product_overview: 125 East Commerce Intelligence is a multi-tenant e-commerce operations and analytics platform that unifies Shopify, payments, logistics, and marketing data into a single dashboard. It is designed to give brands real-time visibility into sales, performance, and operational health across workspaces.
core_goals: Authenticate users and resolve their accessible workspaces securely
Support multi-tenant workspace and brand management
Provide Shopify commerce intelligence with sync and aggregated order metrics
Expose marketing analytics for Meta Ads performance and sync
Provide logistics visibility and NDR recovery actions
Show payment transaction statistics through Razorpay vault data

features.name: Authentication & Session Management
features.description: Verifies the current user session and resolves the authenticated user along with authorized workspaces.
user_flows: GET /api/auth/me -> Receive 200 with authenticated user details and authorized workspaces -> Render dashboard access for the user
GET /api/auth/me with invalid or missing session -> Receive unauthenticated response or empty user context -> Prompt the user to sign in again

features.name: Tenancy & Workspace Management
features.description: Lists existing workspaces and allows creation of a new isolated workspace with a default brand.
user_flows: GET /api/w -> Receive 200 with active workspaces and brand associations -> User selects a workspace for dashboard context
POST /api/w with valid workspace name -> Receive 201 with newly created isolated workspace and default brand -> Workspace becomes available in the workspace list
POST /api/w with missing or invalid name -> Receive 400 validation error -> Workspace is not created

features.name: Shopify Commerce Intelligence
features.description: Provides Shopify order intelligence, including gross sales, net sales, AOV, and order item data, plus on-demand sync.
user_flows: GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/shopify/intelligence/ -> Receive 200 with gross sales, net sales, AOV, and order item data -> Dashboard shows Shopify commerce KPIs for the selected brand

POST /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/shopify/sync-now/ -> Receive 200 confirming sync started or completed -> Refreshed Shopify intelligence is available on subsequent GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/shopify/intelligence/
POST /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/shopify/sync-now/ with missing Shopify credentials or sync preconditions not met -> Receive 400 error payload -> No sync is triggered

features.name: Meta Ads & Marketing Analytics
features.description: Fetches Meta Ads performance facts for 30-day and lifetime reporting and supports on-demand ingestion.
user_flows: GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/marketing/stats/ -> Receive 200 with 30-day and lifetime ad performance facts -> Dashboard displays ROAS, spend, and attribution metrics

POST /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/marketing/sync-now/ -> Receive 200 confirming ingestion request accepted -> Updated marketing stats are available on subsequent GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/marketing/stats/
POST /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/marketing/sync-now/ with invalid or missing ad configuration -> Receive error response -> Marketing sync does not proceed

features.name: Delhivery Logistics & NDR Recovery
features.description: Summarizes shipment logistics metrics and allows NDR reattempt or return-to-origin actions for an AWB.
user_flows: GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/logistics/summary/ -> Receive 200 with aggregate shipment metrics and NDR rate -> User reviews logistics health for the brand
POST /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/logistics/ndr/{awb}/action/ with action set to reattempt -> Receive 200 confirming courier instruction -> Shipment is scheduled for a reattempt
POST /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/logistics/ndr/{awb}/action/ with invalid action value -> Receive 400 validation error -> No NDR action is scheduled

features.name: Razorpay Payments Vault
features.description: Exposes payment transaction statistics and success rates for a brand.
user_flows: GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/payments/stats/ -> Receive 200 with payment transaction stats and success rates -> Payments dashboard shows vault performance
GET /api/w/{slug}/b/{brand_id}/payments/stats/ for a brand with no payment data -> Receive 200 with empty or zeroed stats -> Dashboard shows no-payment-data state
